meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

howto.what: 装上后,用户要求发布前审查时,Claude会先列出未发布的改动并分组,派最多10个ultrabrain代理逐组分析,再调/review-work用5个代理整体审查,最后1个oracle代理评估发布风险、建议版本号并草拟changelog。
howto.when: 只有用户明确要求发布前审查时触发,例如说“pre-publish review”“review before publish”“release review”等。普通发布/发布请求不会触发,直接发布。

howto.what_en: Detects unpublished changes, groups them, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change review, invokes /review-work (5 agents) holistically, and 1 oracle for release synthesis, yielding risk ratings, version bump and changelog draft.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review' etc.). A plain publish/release request must NOT trigger it; /publish ships directly.
